name: Shu Shen
source:
The story based on the background of ancient China. You will play as the role of the crown prince of Yan state, Yan Rushi. 

When facing with so many difficult choices, would you finally help the prince make the right choice? Would you save the endangered state and break the chain of destiny from centuries?

[From [url=https://lordjing.itch.io/forgive-a-god]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事以古代中国为背景。你将扮演燕国太子燕如是。

面对如此多艰难的选择，你最终会帮助王子做出正确的选择吗？你会拯救濒临灭绝的国家并打破几个世纪以来的命运之链吗？

[来自[url=https://lordjing.itch.io/forgive-a-god]Itch.io[/url]]
